run_generate_dataframe: run the script to generate HTML dataframes for TensorFlow datasets
run_generate_dataframe_datasets: run the script to generate HTML dataframes for a comma-separated list of TensorFlow datasets
run_generate_dataframe_dst_dir: run the script to save generated dataframe HTML files to a specified destination directory
run_generate_dataframe_overwrite: run the script to overwrite existing dataframe HTML visualizations
run_generate_dataframe_all: run the script to generate HTML dataframes for all available TensorFlow datasets
